page.api.title: Hosting administration
page.api.intro: Configure this hosting, then scan its QR code in elo when creating a Space.
page.witness.title: Attachment storage
page.witness.intro: Connect the storage used for managed attachments on this hosting.
settings.title: Configuration
settings.api.hint: Hosting settings apply to newly created Spaces.
settings.witness.hint: Saving does not move existing files between providers.
hosting.name.label: Hosting name
hosting.name.hint: Shown in the hosting selector in elo.
retention.hint: Choose the options available when creating a Space.
creation.identities.label: Allowed profile identities
creation.identities.hint: One public profile identity ID per line. These are not passwords or recovery codes.
storage.api.label: Managed attachments
storage.api.hint: Choose the provider already configured in Attachment storage. Its credentials stay on the storage server.
storage.api.private: Managed attachments require Space creation to be limited to selected profile identities.
storage.unavailable: This hosting has no attachment storage broker configured.
storage.provider.label: Storage provider
storage.configured: A connection is saved. Leave credential fields blank to keep it while using the same provider.
storage.new: Enter the credentials for this provider. They are never included in the hosting QR code.
storage.owners.label: Allowed Space owners
storage.owners.hint: One public profile identity ID per line. An empty list does not grant anyone access to managed storage.
mega.folder.label: MEGA folder link
mega.folder.hint: Use the complete folder link, including its decryption key after #.
mega.auth.label: Write access key
mega.auth.hint: Created with MEGAcmd export --writable. This is different from the folder decryption key.
s3.endpoint.label: Endpoint
s3.endpoint.hint: The HTTPS origin of your S3-compatible service.
s3.region.label: Region
s3.bucket.label: Bucket
s3.access.label: Access key ID
s3.secret.label: Secret access key
qr.title: Add this hosting to elo
qr.instructions: In elo, create a Space, choose Add hosting beside the hosting selector, then scan this code.
qr.alt: QR code containing this hosting configuration
qr.link.label: Configuration link
qr.hint: The QR code contains connection settings and public keys, never storage credentials.
qr.unsaved: Save your changes to update this QR code.
status.pending: Applying configuration. This may take a moment…
status.copy.select: The link is selected. Copy it with your browser or keyboard.
error.load: Could not load the configuration. Reload this page to try again.
error.save: Could not save the configuration. Review the settings and try again.
error.session: Your administration session has expired. Reload this page before saving again.
error.connection: The server did not respond. Check your connection before trying again.
error.unknown.save: The save result could not be confirmed. Reload this page to check the saved configuration before submitting again.
error.pending: The configuration is still being applied. Reload this page to check its status.
error.retention: Select at least one message lifetime.
error.identities: Enter public profile identity IDs as 64 hexadecimal characters, one per line.
error.allowlist: Add at least one allowed profile identity, or allow anyone to create Spaces.
error.credentials: Complete the credential fields for the selected provider.
error.qr: The configuration is saved, but its QR code could not be loaded. You can copy the link instead.
logs.title: Logs
logs.help: Live beta errors from devices with Debug enabled. Reports are kept for up to 14 days (10,000 newest reports). This list refreshes every 10 seconds. Crashlytics remains separate. Installation IDs identify app installations, not verified users.
logs.unavailable: Could not load reports. Try again.
